description: SPS unveiled a Missing Person's Gallery at headquarters.
SPS hosted an Explorer recruiting event for young women.
SPS launched its annual Citizen Police Perception Survey.

chips.text: Camp Caterpillar receives proceeds from the annual Pride BBQ.
SPS hosted a calling home ceremony for MMIWG families.

description: Police presented statistics on drivers fleeing peace officers.
Air support unit interventions decreased due to pilot and mechanical issues.

chips.text: Chief McBride explained pilot shortages and mechanical issues reduced air support unit flight time.
Reasons for drivers evading police were not broken down by specific criminal act.
New pilot for air support unit is in training, expected operational by mid-Summer.

description: Saskatoon Police use of force decreased in 2025.
Force was used in 0.17% of calls.
Public Safety Unit made 3 arrests without force.

chips.text: Commissioner Greyeyes noted 0.17% use of force addresses common misconceptions.

description: Police face challenges tracking PACT team availability.
PACT calls are difficult to track due to subjectivity.
PACT teams primarily respond to mental health crises.

chips.text: Chief McBride offered to analyze dispatch data comparing PACT responses to mental health calls.
Residents experiencing mental health crises rely on PACT team availability.
How to accurately track unmet demand for PACT services remains a challenge.
